item.title: Slouching Towards Hedonism
item.description: On speed, play and not pursuing happiness
item.content:encoded:
“Maybe happiness is like a virus. Maybe it's one of those bugs that sits for a long time, so we don't even know that we are infected.” ~Generosity

I’m currently reading the book Generosity by Richard Powers (a brilliant author, highly recommend) and in it the main character, an author who teaches at a local university, is fascinated and stymied by the overwhelming joy that emanates from one of his students. This student, who by all accounts should be beaten down, depressed and forlorn, is a survivor of the Algerian revolution. She lives constantly in peak experience, so much so that he goes to a psychologist to investigate if it’s hypomania, hyperthymia or something else.

Halfway through the book now, I’m am struck by how much of our experience is tempered by our hedonic set point, or your base level of happiness. I’ve been interacting routinely with a number of teams exploring joy and raising this level, so it’s been definitely top of mind. Quite simply, they’re working to tweak neurons so that they’re not sad. Kinda like turning up the color saturation on the world.

Despite being a techno-utopianist, I’m somewhat of a skeptic when it comes to neurotech in general and more broadly think that less is more when it comes to technology. Part of that is because I’ve lived on so little.

I’ve lived at the limits of survival. I’ve been homeless, I’ve suffered from food insecurity, I’ve been abused and had people do terrible things that have left me curled in a ball crying for days. But on the whole I’ve been told that I have a sunny disposition. One of the best compliments I’ve ever received was from my 5th grade teacher who said I had this joie de vivre, a joy of life.

Each day I wake relishing the opportunity to experience this awareness, this overall sense of awe at the absolute strangeness of it all. This is a gentle humble brag because I know many others who are glum, glower and grumpy. Who dwell in the shit and wallow in it, pulling in others to their misery.

It’s not like I never get sad or get the morbs. I LOVE feeling the full range of emotions and can tune the intensity up or down, like I’m playing with the volume on an amp. Once I tune past 11, this gets to the point that it’s almost as if there’s an awareness of otherness, that enables you to feel beyond the bounds of the human body. A proprioception with your social network as almost an extensible organ of humanism.

In The Body Keeps the Score, Bessel writes: “As long as you keep secrets and suppress information, you are fundamentally at war with yourself… The critical issue is allowing yourself to know what you know. That takes an enormous amount of courage.”

To be self-aware means to be honest in everything. This lets you feel completely and to envelop yourself in a trust-based community of other people who are also self-aware. That way you can be vulnerable and feel all the feels because you feel safe in both yourself and around others. This is the highest version of what Maslow calls “belonging” (to which I’ll talk about later).

I think to inhabit these spaces is a skill that can be learned, and while initially uncomfortable, raises your overall hedonic set point (which is why I love communities). This doesn’t have to be engineered via gene therapy or any complicated means, I think past initial self-awareness / honesty, it comes down to three basic principles:

SPEED.

Utopia means “no place” because to really have a world without conflict would also mean no change, no friction. In the show PLUR1BUS, there is a virus from outer space that spreads to infect almost every human except a dozen that are somehow immune. This virus creates a hive mind across the planet in which there is no suffering and everyone is happy. A literal utopia.

In order to achieve that blissful state, you have to sacrifice your mind and give in to the collective. The main character Carol calls bullshit and resists to great hilarity.

I discussed the show with some friends in my house and canvassed them: how many would give up their individuality in order to ease their suffering? How many would join the hive mind?

You’d be surprised at how many people resonate with the aliens and would gladly take on the virus.

In San Francisco there is this drive towards efficiency and optimization. Speeding up processes, removing barriers, streamlining, cutting the fat, making it so that productivity increases exponentially without fail until the singularity. We keep getting better, faster, cheaper, and yet people are miserable, killing ourselves on the altar of birthing an AI god.

In his 1948 seminal paper on Information Theory, Claude Shannon wrote about the effect of _noise in the channel of information transfer between two parties. He specified mathematically that no matter how much static or noise corrupts a signal, you can still send data perfectly if you transmit below a specific speed limit, called channel capacity.

The funny thing about channel capacity is that the human mind kinda sucks in this regard. We don’t do multitasking, arguably we don’t have the ability to parse data more than ~10 bits/sec00808-0) outside of motor function for conscious thought. There’s a massive amount of filtering that happens prior to our awareness. While taking in an insane amount of sensory information at ~1B bits/s. Paradoxically we ingest way more than we consume and the difference between these two number is at the core of anxiety.

Ductility is the physical measure of how easy it is to turn metal into a wire by drawing it through a tiny orifice. One of the byproducts of this industrial process is a ton of heat as friction. The movement of inputs through the tiny bit of awareness is what we do on a daily basis as humans. In our experience of time as linear, we are left with a continual strand of the present moment that is tempered by how ductile we parse every moment.

Mechanical-industrial processes work on the basis of speeds and feeds. These two settings control what rate of processing and how much material is fed in. One of the easiest ways to control your base level of happiness is to minimize input and slow down the rate of processing.

This is why mediation works. Closing your eyes, focusing on breath, being intentional about clearing mental space such that you bring awareness to your body. Meditation is one of the main ways that you can bring attention to the friction in your life that is caused by trying to shove in an overwhelming amount of shit into a brain that is not designed for that.

This friction is where meaning is created. It is where being present really matters. Do you ever wonder why during times of near death experiences that times slows down? It’s meant as your brain’s reaction to overwhelming stimuli to remain in the moment.

The Navy Seals repeat a saying often: slow is smooth and smooth is fast. In moments of high stress, I often repeat the mantra “you have more time” to myself as a gentle reminder that life is a lot longer and my mind can only do so much. This has brought so much ease to me in the high intensity activities I find myself in, and allowed me to welcome in more risk and more complexity.

Slow mornings, allowing the mind to work through deeper and longer thoughts is (in my opinion) the best way to live. Going slow and taking your time means there’s a greater awareness, a presence and attention, which also means overall more joy.

The same holds true in relationships. If you’re constantly rushing around during moments together, having urgency in everything, racing to the finish in life, sex, love, work, family, and more, what kind of world are you building for yourself?

Love comes when you allow yourself to slow down and luxuriate in the experience of another. When you go slow it also allows a far more enjoyable thing to occur:

PLAY.

I have this habit of starting strange traditions. Whether it’s lighting a pinata on fire for my birthday, setting up a Nic Cage film festival, or running a half-marathon in honor of Lawnchair Larry, I do my best to bake goofiness into the fabric of my existence. To be labeled as weird and interesting is a high compliment because as pattern-matching freaks, it is the strangeness that slows people down and allows us to pay attention. But importantly, I don’t do things for that attention, I do things because I enjoy them.

Without play in your life, it is harder to learn, to grow, to truly dance with concepts that would normally be scary. There’s such a fear of appearing to not know what you’re doing. Plot twist: nobody knows what the fuck they’re doing. So practice in public. Because it feels good.

Animals play-hunt, babies babble, and quite honestly nobody really cares that you suck at painting, video work or that strange poem about the gunk between your toes. The default mode is that you’re the only one paying attention to the things you’re doing (see the section above). As long as you’re having a good time trying new/weird things, nothing else matters. This kind of experimentation brings transformative change, discovery and more. We imagine new worlds of possibility when we allow ourselves the safety of play.

It’s when we tie value (including self-worth and identity) to creative work is when we undermine the joy inherent in just doing things. I consistently advise founders that they are not their company (and they consistently don’t listen). I consistnetly mispell words with the recognition that it’s a way we’ve come up with new ones. Life is deeply ridiculous and a very unserious place.

There’s an inherent tension in the mind between the creative self and the editor. In the War of Art, Steven Pressfield labels this cognitive dissonance, this forceful problematic persistent challenge as The Resistance. By separating the internal editor from the creative, you can overcome this resistance. Sometimes that involves writing drunk and editing sober, sometimes that involves large blocks of languid time where you can just exist without expectation. The creative fluidity that comes happens when you make time for play and allow yourself to be messy without editing.

A film that made an impact on my creative process is Everything is a Remix. The main thesis is that any creative work is a remix of another and they provide an extraordinary number of surprising examples. I would extend upon this thesis slightly to say that the other creative force is destruction. Allowing yourself to make a mess, to destroy and tear down something is part of how you make something new. San Francisco would be nothing without the 1906 fire. The twin forces of remix and destruction are a way to shape the world, gain agency and see joy permeate through work. You’re dancing on the edge of the possible and it’s even more enjoyable to do it with others.

One of my favorite things to witness is people playing together, particularly improvisational music. Every week on my street there’s this jazz club that has a band play. Understanding that these people are creating in the moment just on the basis of vibes and what feels good is so awe-inspiring to witness. It’s the letting go of control and outcome that allows this beauty to emerge. You’ll always let yourself down if your expectations are anything more than the basics of doing a thing. Control has a place internally but not externally.

The amount of anxiety I see from people listening to the news is insane, so much so that Johnny Harris (a guy who reports on the news) has a Subway Take of people not consuming the news. It’s something outside of our sphere of influence and locus of internal personal control. To bring happiness back to your life is to focus on the things you can play with, not war, famine, strife.

More recently I’ve been asking people: “what is your favorite San Francisco whimsy?” I’ve gotten responses ranging from Big Wheel Racing, to the world’s largest pillow fight, to the Bush Man and more. Makes me want to host Whimsycon (speculative) to bring together more playful people.

One of the best things in the arsenal of play is to change your relationship with time by making it a routine tradition or ritual. For me that looks like morning writing, weekly dinners, monthly trips of “going to church” where I dance until I can’t feel my body, quarterly wonder-filling experiences and annual traditions set my calendar so I slow down, have things to look forward to and understand the rhythm of life has a place for discovery/creativity in all things.

But where to direct all of this living? Happiness is a warm gun and you can either point it at yourself or aim beyond.

WHY.

What’s your happiest moment? Mine was leaving home the day after my 25th birthday to move to California. I loaded the back of my beat-up 2003 Chevy Malibu lovingly named Muriel and drove off into the sunset cackling and crying with laughter. I was on the way to the west, chasing a dream I had since as far as I could remember to head out to the mythic land of queen Calafia.

My dream was to be an algae farmer, to culture and cultivate the slime sublime and had secured some funding from the founder of Soylent in Los Angeles to set up my lab and practice at the edge of the possible.

Heart full, I was full-sending to an unknown future and had surety that this was the right steps. All because I was self-actualizing towards purpose.

Deep in the middle of the Holocaust, in the overcrowded flea-ridden starving bunks of Auschwitz, Viktor Frankl dreamed of a time beyond the camps. He had a deep certainty, a visualization of him sharing a life philosophy with the world in packed lecture halls across the globe. The thing that carried him forward beyond horror after unspeakable tragedy was Logotherapy.

Logotherapy stems from Logos, or purpose. His core concept holds simply, that if you have a why, you can bear any how.

Another way to put this is to chase after happiness, you wind up being habitually unhappy. To chase after purpose, you wind up at happiness. The people that I know of that are self-actualizing are the ones that are fundamentally enjoying life more than others. They tend to have a solidity and surety that is enviable, that enables them to move past whatever difficulty they have in life. This is all because there is something beyond themselves that they are working towards. Somewhat similar to the philosophy of the stoics (something I may write about at a later time).

Part of the way that I build my life is to understand that you cannot go after self-actualization until you’ve tackled the other rungs of Maslow’s hierarchy of needs. The base foundational level involves food, water, and shelter, something that, in a surprising twist of fate, many of us do not have even in the Western world. As you ascend up the rungs of Maslow’s Hierarchy of Needs, you end up at belonging and community, which is part of my focus of work, my core strength. Finally at the very top of the hierarchy, you end up at self-actualization or purpose-driven work. This is a calling beyond yourself that you can throw meaning into. If you don’t have a greater purpose or calling in life then the main point of what you should be working on is to discover your purpose.

A way to understand your logos is to actively filter through another concept called ikigai. Ikigai shows that you cannot just pursue your main calling but it also has to make money, create goodness, and you eventually have to be skilled at whatever task you set yourself to. If you check all four of these boxes then whatever you end up doing it will be fulfilling.

The sad fact of the capitalistic system we are born into is that you require money to survive. To live at the limits of survival is something in which you don’t accomplish the basic bottom foundation of Maslow’s hierarchy of needs. More recently there was an economic experiment that showed that anything beyond $70,000 (cost-of-living adjusted in the US) was considered extra and did not contribute to people’s base level of happiness. While tenuous conclusions aside, the core concept here is solid: people do not require additional money to make them happy. Money does not buy happiness. What they do require beyond a baseline is respect for their work, purpose behind their work, and an understanding of the future they are shaping.

I encounter two types of people in my life. There are those that are waiting to die and there are others who are rushing to live. I’m sure that you have found these people in your wanderings and understand what it means when someone is waiting to die. It is because they have yet to find their core why, their main reason for living and end up spending their days in distraction, dissociation and dispair.

Some end up finding this through children or work or helping others but on the whole we exist in a world that is bereft of meaning. When you surround yourself by those who are actively pursuing purpose, you bring color back into your life and understand that you too can change the way the world works. That’s part of why I enjoy creating communities of play in which people can discover what their true purpose is.

CONCLUSION.

There’s this inherent tension to being human—we didn’t ask to be here and yet we exist in this beautiful chaotic mess, of having to figure out how to be in the world. Vonnegut said it best: “Hello babies. Welcome to Earth. It’s hot in the summer and cold in the winter. It’s round and wet and crowded. On the outside, babies, you’ve got a hundred years here. There’s only one rule that I know of, babies-”God damn it, you’ve got to be kind.”

The core of human experience, of having to figure out how to be in the world without guidance is overwhelming and it is easy to give in to nihilism, pessimism and aimlessness. But that’s no fun. The gallows humor is that nobody makes it out alive, so why not lean into the joy of experience?

To slow down and feel the friction, to play at the edge of the possible with others, to discover a purpose beyond yourself, all of that is at your fingertips. Now make it happen.

item.title: Better in Every Way
item.content:encoded:
Brian was completely average. He had gotten top marks at MIT in neurobiology and went on to study advanced quantum computing for his PhD, later transitioning into a career in neurosurgery, studying for 13 years before becoming a full time resident. However, the decision to become a doctor was his downfall.

He should have seen all the signs. The AI assistants, the surgery robots, the overbearing weight of the insurance system squeezing out all of the juice of the process of medicine, the MBA-ification of the healthcare system. But no, Brian was average and Brian couldn’t outperform the most recent versions of the surgery bots.

Also they did it with such flair and panache it was like they were showing off. Did they really have to break into a choreographed dance routine after they removed a gallbladder? Did they have to also autosend flowers and console loved ones?

Brian had lost his first and second romantic partners to the newest surgical resident, AX-05, lovingly called Axos. They were just so good and smooth in their movements, it only made sense that a robot could please them better than he could.

Brian sat on the bridge and contemplated his choices. He looked down at his hands, nimble and dexterous for a human, but completely average compared to the speed and agility of AX-05. He decided to jump.

On the way down an ambulance bot saw him falling and swooped down to grab him before he hit the water, dosing him with some antidepressants and bundling him to the hospital to the waiting caring arms of AX-05.

item.title: ask softly
item.content:encoded:
Please excuse my broken bits
they fell like Legos on the floor
and I’ve been meaning to pick them up
but if you want
I’d like for you to stay awhile
and help me arrange the pieces
so they don’t hurt while walking
it goes a lot quicker with someone else
and we could build beautiful things

please
I didn’t mean to scare you off
where do the words go
when they die in your mouth
how do they taste
fighting down your throat
like an octopus
reaching for openness
choking out life

I feel like I’m undressing
on the beach in the wind
no towel
bruised bloody and wet
it’s so cold in your eyes
come closer and kiss me
so we can close our eyes
and see with our hands
I want to tell you about all my scars
I want to make up secrets
just so I can tell you them
I want
you
for the first time in a long time
I’m asking questions

I’ve started this ritual
a ceremony almost
every evening I pretend
I’m made of something new

item.title: atonement
item.content:encoded:
I want this poem to feel like a kiss
to have the taste of plums as a parting gift
I want to feel the space between us
the hollow where your body fit mine
stretch across timezones
I want long trips to not feel like pits
rotting into knots in my stomach
feeling like a strawberry milkshake

Instead
I want to hear the song of your voice
smooth and soft in my ear
the drumbeat of your heart
your pupils dilating
our bodies intertwined
so many things to say while
writing our story together

That’s how I want our goodbyes to be
rituals traditions last rites
building together
just to figure out what it means
on the other side when we say:
"Hi"

It is Yom Kippur
I beat my chest and I am sorry
for all the questions I did not ask
tumbling and left behind like laundry
I am sorry for the imperative clause
I am sorry for an almost perfect weekend
I am sorry for leaving
I guess we needed some angst?

this is just to say
I let the edges of myself melt in our heat
failing to hold that
we do not deserve each other
I don’t deserve a thing
I wanted to shout from my tiger rooftop
drown out dark loud thoughts
so overwhelmed by feeling
my body has been tingling
but I didn’t want to embarrass you
so instead it all feels like a secret
that I don’t ever want to forget

it is brave to remember the good things
my face still hurts from the laughter
another joke for the bucket
not enough hands to hold this feeling
that there’s never enough time from
airport to airport
work and cation
where is the meaning
the balance
goats, horses, dead possum, vulture hawk, wild boar, lizard all a sign
sentience is holy
is this holy? are we holy?
smoke signals kept us inside
mindblowing sex
morning rides like flying
risotto at sunset
climbing trees
acro yoga
climbing each other
showers together
each and every kiss
felt like a solstice to me

I’m still trying to parse my thoughts
they run together like my ink
this is just to say
this matters
you matter
we matter
let’s take our time

item.title: babble
item.content:encoded:
I tell myself
just because she writes you poems
she owes you nothing
just because she kissed you
covered in grease in the garage
that can change in an instant
just because you want it to mean something
doesn’t mean that it has to

This tension is like a rubber band
stretching across oceans
bound to break
You tell yourself
building bridges in flood plains
is a recipe for collapse during moonsons

So tame desire
keep the borders of your self solid
do not run like a refugee
from the disaster inside
seeking a safe haven

Long ago you recognized home is made within
not found by hollowing out another
each poem like a salvo in some strange battle
of trying to connect
a tower babbling

There are 1000 languages here and I am trying to understand ours
Mis reglas son para darle sentido a estos momentos
मुझे आपकी बहुत परवाह है
ਮੈਂ ਸਪੇਸ ਅਤੇ ਟਾਈਮ ਬਣਾਉਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦਾ ਹਾਂ
.. / .-- .- -. - / - .... .. ... / ... .--. .- -.-. . / - --- / -... . / ... . -.-. .-. . -
int main() {
std::cout << "what do you want from this?";
return 0;
}

Are you willing to explore with me?
there are mountains to be climbed
it all is a balance
the weather can change in an instant
I hope these tensions are tamed
my thoughts no longer saboteurs

freedom of movement
freedom of expression
freedom of mind
freedom of heart
Free

item.title: before leaving
item.content:encoded:
A poem is not a promise
and I can tell you’re scared
by the silence you hold in your teeth
the wounds make some madness
and you’re afraid I’ll claim something deep
I am used to those who run
The way to calm a stampede
is to run alongside them until tired
they allow themselves to settle into pasture
Your mind is a stampede
Trying to trample down your own insides
I am not your ghost
I am not here to claim your insides
I do not seek trophies
I am as wild as you are
I am as free now as I ever have been
There is nothing I need from you that I cannot create
Yet
I see goodness in you
joy spreading like fingers
licking rooftops dancing birds
This city is magic and we are witches
let us cast spells on each other
so enchanting are we
drunk on laughter
dancing on each other’s feet
so eager and hopeful
so tender and true
why hate the end before any beginning
because tomorrow begins and ends new

item.title: caged bird
item.content:encoded:
The day I met you
I was blind to your eyes
deep ice blue-green
so familiar
I don’t think you could see
where my ribcage was cracked
making dumb jokes is a type of bandage
for open heart surgery
pretending laughter is better than sertraline
that’s just to say
I was doing my best to forget
so I cried on the floor of a strange room
in a strange city
full of strange people
whose faces seemed like questions
hanging like hooks around my shoulders
too afraid to go outside
too broke to stay inside
I wished I was a bird in the rain
staring out the window
hungry
and it wouldn’t stop raining
and my wings were cut
I ached like the time I spit out my teeth
my pain a sorry meal
that much easier to whistle the night away

item.title: count
item.content:encoded:
My first kiss was a secret shared
whispers and giggles
so young playground playing around
feeling forever in weeks
not knowing how to speak
holding hands on the bus
it was hard enough to make eye contact
a thrown barbie in the basement

My second kiss was discussed at length
a crush caught in the stairwell
feeling the world from lips to cheek
not knowing how to speak
my favorite color her favorite color
de colores se visten los campos en la primavera

My third kiss cut my lip
braces locked split
second before the bell rang
head jerk fireworks
grinned like a fool
feeling the blood run down in a streak
not knowing how to speak
middle school girls are evil incarnate
tortured like a bull in Spain

My fourth kiss I was so nervous
I brought index cards
her spine curved like a question
my body an answer so close
feeling dark us freaks and geeks
not knowing how to speak
she drew a heart on my hand in sharpie
I colored it in every day
writing letters at summer camp
to give to her when I returned
it wasn’t the same

it hurts that I lost count, the thousands of kisses that led me here
so start over
a secret, a discussion, a cut, nervous energy
it all feels new
writing letters over the summer
retracing a name scratched on my body
a name spelled you

item.title: dream drunk
item.content:encoded:
I wish you could bite my lip so the taste of your teeth would stay with me
when you oscillate my metallic sonatas our colorless ideas sleep furiously
I love making your eyes roll as you fight against making noise
a groan, a moan, a laughing tone, I’d stop if I knew you were truly annoyed
with the number of times I’ve been sent to jail I could start a legal revolt
these words sweet reflections of my desire, the joy at what I’ve wrote
I know you hate rhyming poems which is why I use this to tease
break the line for these poems are the best way I know how to show I care
it’d be overly sweet to claim that when our bodies meet it feels like prayer
even in the darkest times we’re rivers intertwined the joy still runs deep
dark blue of a cenote the calm promise of this care is yours to keep
I know you’re a lion, I afraid I might only be a lamb
at least I’m not a fucking goat, I’d hate myself goddamn
For our Halloween costume we could be asleep
I think that might be something each of us need

item.title: end at the beginning
item.content:encoded:
shhhh
it is wrong to express your joy so loudly
this mind is a library
walk softly and carry your baggage
don’t drop it too quick on my toes
I’m tired
I’m tired of being tired
it’s a ride and I want to get off
all of the guts are spilling out
all at once
I’m embarrassed
I’m embarrassed of being embarrassed
to say vulnerability is like
running naked backwards through a cornfield
hoping you don’t trip and fall

when you get cut
or bit by a rattlesnack
they tell you to suck the venom out
then spit as hard as you can
before the pain curdles in your mouth

can’t you see I’m trying
but people don’t see the try
flipping to the back of the book
you see the ending first
to figure out if it’s good to read

this is just to say
when you’re thinking about endings
it’s hard to enjoy the taste of sunshine
dribbling down your chin
your tremble and tremor feels like an earthquake
may you jump and never find ground
headspun with wings aplenty
kiss the light
run forward into my widespread arms
whatever may come

item.title: end with me
item.content:encoded:
There are butterflies in the garden and I am happy
There is a hurricane going on somewhere else but here
it’s the eye of the storm for a bit
and I can sit and sip coffee
and send you memes
and be amazed at being alive
the cabbages are coming in
I’d love to share one with you when you get back

item.title: first to last
item.content:encoded:
fall is the season for apple picking
and apple was my first word
I said it as an interruption
when my family was making sauce
because I wanted to be included

it’s bittersweet how belonging
isn’t enough to just be
it has to have longing tacked on
and maybe I’ll run out of clothes for you to borrow
and maybe these aren’t the right words
and maybe I’m not fast enough but
I go slow because I want to savor this
savor us

I’m so tired that
I’ve been failing to dream
nightmares are for people with things to lose
teeth, trophies, clothes and minds
I want to know what scares you

Here’s what scares me:
tasting the metal of you hitting your head
like smashing pumpkins
the day after Halloween
fear is the mind murder
this an imposition
like dancing on motorcycles
this damn thing is cursed

I don’t want fears to shape
the space between our bodies
especially when
my mind fails me
with memories like quicksand
sometimes I’m drowning
sometimes I remember to breathe

you help me remember
looking back I always assume
these are the best days
even at their worst

And sometimes I want you to feel the scratchiness of my beard
because it’s only that way for a short time
And sometimes I want to feel hurt
so I know how good things really are
And sometimes
breathing in the smell of head and shoulders two-for-one
I thank how holy it is
every morning a sunrise
these happy few minutes drowning together
breathing in your sand
before waking up

item.title: fly
item.content:encoded:
hey baby bird
pushing towards the edge
clamoring crying me too
don’t jump yet
your feathers ain’t big enough
you’d fall and splat
hey baby bird
just hold tight
I’m sure mama is coming
I can tell you’re hungry
me too
I can tell you’re cold
me too
I can tell in this cramped nest
you’re itching to escape
me too me too
mama is coming
the world is bright and big
and can crush the life out of you
in one fell swoop
and I’m sitting here in the airport
watching eyes wide
making a nest of my bags and my life
tiny heart crying for change
me too
wings too small to fly away
I hope you can hold the weight of it all
the weight of you
that you grow strong
before the days feel heavy
me too me too

item.title: garbage is what we call other people’s memories
item.description: garbage is what we call other people’s memories
item.content:encoded:
isolation is the gift
I masturbate until it doesn’t help anymore
I write until it doesn’t help anymore
I eat until it doesn’t help anymore
I stay up late bingeing shows until it doesn’t help anymore
insomniac lobotomized nostalgia
Amazing how much you can’t get done when you don’t want to think

Instead, I sleep with strange dreams of Armageddon
I do not belong here
I walk until my feet blister
I do not belong here
End to end to end to end
singing soft songs to myself of broken wings
I do not belong here
I’m given a bracelet that says:
"it’s all about how you dance in the rain"
so you climb Bernal every day in bad weather
and walk the labyrinth to clear the mind
at least it isn’t LA

My grandparents used to walk the beaches together every morning
like I used to walk the beaches down south
picking up sea glass
hundreds of pounds of the stuff
A testament of their love, of time
we still don’t know what to do with it
it sits in trash bags in storage

I cleared out my storage unit
everything down to a backpack
a suitcase
burned the rest
my broken bike sold for parts
I am but pieces of a man
leaving quietly in the night

item.title: grab this rope
item.content:encoded:
my brain is so noisy
full of a hurricane of wool
molasses in a tornado
circling and tumbling
I’m angry and normally I can throw it
but I’m a mess
and I can’t speak
I want to roar
but my throat is caged
I’m restless today and all the days
i just hide it well
I’m angry and it needs to go somewhere
I bounce it like a ball
so I strain against whatever feels like a prison

I asked you to temper your fear
you decided to put your head inside the lion’s mouth
you don’t have to whip me to tame me
it won’t work
let me be wild in my ways
I’ll let you be feral in yours

I want to roar with you
I want to hunt and kill and feast on the vultures
they caw as if to say carry on
pecking and picking and tearing
away bits of flesh every time
until I’m a ship being plundered of treasure

these stories are all I have
and I hear you call them worthless
while throwing open your chest of war-torn spoils
to stare at me through your kaleidoscope jewels
like fake beer goggles from the past
daring me to walk the plank

please don’t ever ask me to choose
between the horizon and the ground
I’m not digging a grave
I want to be running at something that isn’t a wall
I want to be beyond this
beyond it all
I want you to come with me

I’m not asking, I’m showing
this isn’t loyalty it’s courage
this isn’t a scam
stop treating me like a long con
there isn’t a chance at mutiny if there are no captains
you once told me your thoughts were an ocean
prove it
don’t dash me against the rocks
I’m holding on to you like driftwood
to keep from being pulled away
this is my angry gauntlet and it’s thrown
hand over hand in hand
breathe steady and deep
and trust that we won’t drown each other

item.title: gratitude is another breath
item.content:encoded:
There is nothing lonelier than a dial tone
There is nothing more sacred than to listen to the deep breathing as your lover falls asleep next to you
I feel the rubber band of us stretch across time zones
Across bruises and electrocutions and sunburns and it’s like breathing
I breathe you in each morning
And breathe you out at the end of each day
Holding my breath to try to keep your laugh inside me
Escaping out in my dreams
A full body smile
Thank you for being alive
Thank you for being alive
Thank you for being alive
It is so precious to spend time in this way
It is so meaningful to write these words
To speak these truths
To feel it all in my body
Breathless and wild we are
What dreams may come

item.title: hallowed
item.content:encoded:
I wish I could write like a man possessed by the spirits of Neruda, Plath, Oliver, Rumi
sitting on this Yucatan ghost
remembering our weekend together
my fingers in your hair
you’re stealing my dreams
a polterheist
it’s fundamental feeled theory
we’re entangled so this is some
spooky action at a distance
I want to haunt you
ouija dance with me?
tiki tipsy mixing red rum
you used your devilish tongue
to read my palms like psalms
make a human sacrifice lighting me up
smoke signals burned our lungs
I’m glad we found a cation to stay inside
well tis the season
what a treat
lay my heart at your feet like a meal
a perfect time to rip out my throat to check for ticks
holding close to listen before I let the zephyr blow through it
I cut off and leave you a hand to hold
I’m sure I can find more
like some kind of Adam’s family reunion
let us snap each other up
naked and shivering in our shadows
warmed by the burning giraffe on your arm
I see this every day on my wall at Agape
walking like a man
Truthfully I am now sur de real
Cuando regrese,
fundamonos el uno en la otra
como una vela quemamos en ambos extrenos
we are clocks
this is an escape room there is only so much time
good thing I have a magnet
and you’ve got steel in your soul
it pulls me to you
the costumes we never planned
the ones we wear now
how well does it fit?
I wish I could rip it all off with my teeth
while you nibble a carrot into a voodoo doll
these snacks are table stakes
fangs to you these thoughts
devour my skull into a brain stew
if you are what you eat then it’s vegetarian
swallow and feel me inside you
I’m trying not to eat so this time goes fast
it might be taboo to think these feelings will last
but for now I’ll stumble in a holy daze
carrion a sacrifice at the altar to a goddess I praise

item.title: hand it to you
item.content:encoded:
I don’t know if I’d be good at it but
I want to run my fingers through your hair
past all the worry lines
I could take a sip of joy with you
and pray that this warmth I feel
deep in my chest travels across the space between us
through my rough hands
down your neck
like a drum beat
seeps like tea
into your soul

item.title: i am but a mouth
item.content:encoded:
When they tell you it takes guts
believe them
life is lemons
you’re shaken not stirred so drink up
feel the twist in your stomach
that tastes like truth
it’s an unruly bitch
for the first time in your life
try not to disappear
this righteous anger that’s been stewing inside you
makes for a fortified broth
no need to swallow insults
when you get punched in the face
punch back
this is an all out brawl
a fist fight with good intentions
how foolish was it to suffer fools
keep it cool and take an eye
steal yourself for the gods
seek out the blind
and give them something to talk about
you no longer kiss, you’ve got bite
so when you tear into a frog
don’t let it catch in your throat instead
screaming because you are no longer a void
every night that drags on
let it be known that you’re collecting dog tags
because to be truly unleashed
you can’t have anything to bitch about
cry havoc and let loose
wash it away
no more tears
it’s everyone else who needs to fear

item.title: in time we all self immolate
item.description: in time we all self immolate
item.content:encoded:
I crossed an ocean
and when I landed checked my map
Delighted at how I am further
and farther than I’ve ever been
There’s this drumbeat this loud sound
deep deep in me
thrumming
making me move
pushing me far
my engine
my freedom
my reason

my terror
raised up like a wave late at night
This is ending this is ending this is ending
the quiet comprehending
I would make my ex remove her watch before coming to bed
During shiva we cover mirrors
reset the clocks trying to save daylight
clocks are a type of mirror

I grew up held in difference
100 countries, 40 languages
a minority means where I feel myself
the edges of me into the edges of you
melting like chocolate fondue
frying like harissa carrot pomegranate pancakes
we ache for the taste

our Spanish immersion class learned math
the foreign syllables on our tongues
every year we’d have 100 day
each student bringing in 100 of
something to count in spanish
I brought paperclips
later
learning you could trade paperclips for a house
learning the world might end in paperclips
I wish I brought something different

I once listened to a friend, an astronaut
describe the feeling
of opening the cupola
and looking back at the planet
bathed in earthglow
feeling the edges of self melt away
flooded with love
overwhelmed into tears
pooling in their eyes
in the dark of space

I can feel time pull at me
tugging insistent like a child at my sleeve
pulling me towards something greater
away from a shadow
towards the light
both of them me
I’ll keep trying to send messages
through the ether
only receiving return to sender

There is a palace here built on the hill
That was cursed
and to lift the curse required blood
a willing volunteer
to be entombed inside
for all time
Is it a curse that I hear?
Is it tinnitis?
Is it the child chasing me?
Throwing paperclips at my heels
They built the palace by sliding blocks of stone on slabs of ice
and waiting for them to melt

I am a palace built of ice waiting to melt
to settle in to the right places
to entomb the past as sacrifice
trying to bask in earthlight
hearing the room full of clocks hidden away at the center
tick tick tick winding down

item.title: irreplaceable
item.content:encoded:
What do you do when you can see someone else about to be lonely?
I am but a body holding a place in line
I am but a shattered mirror I am what bored people do on a Saturday afternoon
I have hands that can fill spaces but I don’t have enough hands
I can hear your panting need
I can see where I used to shape the clay of myself to fit the gaps
you can see the light of self shining through
I am useful I am used and please fill my
mouth with the taste of danger
to fall into this again is electric
I throb and moan and bite my tongue
put something inside me and give me something to bite down on
But no -
this anticipation is delicious
actually -
even more now than ever
there is a clear wall where my shadow lies
I am tied and gagged and bound
but I’ve done the knots myself
I am no longer begging
to fill my bowl with you
I am more than a snack I am a meal
I can say no
I can say later
I can… this is just to say
we are different
we are you and I
separate
on a hot day the last thing I want is soup
I trust me to trust myself
stop thrusting myself
instead knowing I am someone else
I want to take my time
It is easy to drown the self in the roar and rush of sweat
It is hard and special to know
to deeply know
to know more than anything
that I am whole and complete
I am irreplaceable
I am not with or without desire
I am enough I am enough I am enough

item.title: it’s simple love
item.content:encoded:
Bats hear shapes
Plants eat light
Bees dance maps
and my heart
it sings for you

we can hold
all these wonderous things
in the soft curve of the morning

item.title: last meal
item.content:encoded:
I want to sip on my ashes with you
I want to dance on our graves
I want to paint frescos in AB negatives
let the cyano smiles dessicate
needless to say I want to commit sacrilege with you
invent religions
then burn down our own churches
pretending to believe in nothing but
really believing in each other
I want to ask you every question
I hate that my sunsets are your sunrise
I love that my sunrise is your sunset
I’m a night owl
I’m sorry I said something about your pigeon noise
there are so many sides to this
and so little time
Do you trust me?
dumb Disney question instead:
would you let the weary ache of our bones form an aqueduct together?
would you kiss a kindness deep into my soul to twist our heartbeats in the wind?
would you steal my memories and make a last sorry meal of them?
I am the murderer
I wish there was a way I could eat your pain
cut my tongue in two
sharp like papercuts
I do not wish to dance on your knife
I will fall on the blade
I will dissemble my desire
picked apart like a sky burial
federated into boxes in the attic
swept under the rug
sleeping on the couch
I slept in the back of a tricycle with a lawnmower engine
flying through a country with 100 languages
hoping to hear yours
I could sleep anywhere
I would sleep on the ground
listen to your twitches above me
feeling the space soften
knowing when it is important
I will make promises and keep them

item.title: limerence
item.content:encoded:
Sound is touch at a distance
so let’s read to each other in bed
I hope you don’t think I’m another hypnogogic jerk
I want nothing more than to make nonsense words
until our mouths find better things to do
like licking elbows
our bodies free and wild
cover ourselves in oil
and slide around on the floor pretending to be slugs
entangled, my fingers in your hair
blowing up condom balloons
howling at moons
playing bananagrams to spell out
L-I-M-E-R-E-N-C-E
and other obscure sorrows
I wake up with so many things to tell you
I go to sleep with so many things my body aches to give you
I promise I’ll be home soon

write with me:
I wish you could bite my lip so the taste of your teeth would stay with me
in the echo of my skull the finger of your mind lingers

They say flesh has a memory
So let’s talk it through and the routines that you tongue can trace
You don’t know the games these memories play
Or what id give to have another peice locked away
To come and go when I know you can’t stay

this bed is too big for just one body
let’s dip these weary bones to steep
in the dark we blend like soup skin salty
a moan is a secret promise to keep

item.title: love to the point of invention
item.description: love to the point of invention
item.content:encoded:
I wish I didn’t remember my jacket
On the back of your kitchen chair
So you’d have something
that smelled of me
because saying words like
I like the shape of your thoughts
the sweet wickedness of your tongue
on full display
and how they jig and jagsaw
cutting through the haze of Delhi
each word a fruit bursting
ripe and juicy and filled with seeds
planted deep in my brain
is not enough
it’s not enough to invent a language
to play hide and seek
to lose at staring contests
to remember the warmth on the mountain
sitting under old trees who have seen this before
to hear the whoosh of a heartbeat in your ears
the calm knowing
that there is a space that sits
between the swoop of your neck
and your back
that fits my lips
the softness of your ocean eyes
I know I am a memory
I know I am a poet
I know I am true
I dare us to lie
down down deep
miles away
your echo a shadow next to me
whisper me to sleep

item.title: monsoon
item.content:encoded:
the rains came and stayed
you think they had other places to be
but they dumped their troubles here
and the basement flooded
so gummed up and full of tomorrow’s jobs
we stood in freezing cold socks
bailing brown water
getting heavier instead of dancing dry

there’s this pressure that builds and builds
right before the eyes
from restless nights
and untamed mind
water flows down down down
until unsettled you can’t help but shake
wringing out sobs
formed into shapes
are you a man or a bag of sand?

it’s been weeks since I’ve written
and weeks since I’ve lied
where does time run off to
when it finally calls it a day

a heartbeat is a white noise machine
my eyes flutter and beat against panes
I miss the heat of a candle
let me curl around it and burn

item.title: no more secrets
item.content:encoded:
We used to tell the bees the important things
now we stumble over syllables
watching murmurations through mirrors
Soft stones break bones and it’s these
Leaded gifts which become worn with anticipation
wear with me in their anticipation
We both dabble around waiting
To bite, catch flight
To get where we mean
At the bottom of the world, the emperor penguin gives a smooth pebble memento
Scratched and cold, bought and sold
to carry the heart so that we skip in tempo
Who houses the home to hide what the mouth can’t fit
The flowers are blooming late this season
Each blossom aching for secrets
wild one, are you ever fully planted?
shame they say dandelions are a debasement
when the whispered truth behind ocean eyes is stormy amazement

The animals know when it’s about to rain
They grow quiet in anticipation
why place stones instead of flowers
life is but death’s hesitation

This pause before the break
shatter before the aches
it feels like deception
it’s a shelter from the wave
the shadow from the grave
Two joined at the reflection

Taste the echo and tell me
how bitter the rind in your teeth
the heart of a plum
juice dribbling down your chin
what are we but secrets that we cannot keep

Blood red auto-cannibalism
you only dance alone

item.title: noisy season
item.content:encoded:
After every conference I worry I’m dying
that the people I love are dying
That newtons first law applies
and that if I stop moving I’ll never start again
That the next year I won’t be the same
I won’t see the same people
That I’ll be too tired
or they will have moved on
and that the brief interludes when we harmonize
will unsync into noise
That the echo of their voices will stop reverberating my ear
That I’ll forget and be forgotten
that the only time life feels like an episode of friends
when I can gather my people around me like a blanket
is when we are worried about jobs and money and unimportant things
because we’re about to be cast out like seeds into wind
sown across the world and I’ll be alone trying to dig deep roots with nobody to lean on
I’ll topple so I shake because it’s all a storm
coming on quick then gone
where do they all go when you find home in other people
it all feels like front doors slamming
and another early morning
get up, get into a borrowed car and drive

item.title: old eyes
item.content:encoded:
I want my eyesight to get worse
so we can share glasses
the blurry shapes of each other blending
like coffee and tea
your fast breath and my fast heartbeat
making for slow mornings
you told me that you want me to be as restless as you
I’ve been testing it out but I’ve got another flavor
rather than anger
I’m trying for fierce joy
the kind that bites your lip and the taste of teeth
the kind that paces like a tiger high above
the kind that flies down pavement arms outstretched hugging the world come what may
let me leap out of bed only to return to you
let me flee my house only to find home
let us dance and play and make and sing
and on quiet days
I will ask you to sing to me
and I hope you will ask for a bedtime story

item.title: prescription
item.content:encoded:
This is a prescription, take it or leave it
like drugs wary of overdose
a few words each day
pacing on the phone
laughter spilling from lips
always moving
You are a flowchart
You are a muse calliope
harmony in our voices
at first
child-like and babbling
falling over each other
sweet like plums given freely
You are so good
you smell of salt and fire
like cool summer storms
your heart thundering
we read each other like maps
comparing scars
tracing outlines of stories yet to be told
we are a collection of maybes
maybe it’s always a maybe
no expectations
no promises
no captains no masters
it will hurt
the best things seem to
do it anyways

item.title: romance is the shape formed between two people
item.description: romance is the shape formed between two people
item.content:encoded:
My definition of romance
has a lot to do with something I once learned from a sculptor
she said that you can treat the space between two people
like a piece of artwork
feel the contours of it like a living breathing thing
and lean into the shape of it
to understand when it is finally safe to fall asleep
because being in love is like falling asleep in class
slow then all of the sudden fast
tumbling and bumbling
I can’t romance you
it’s not a verb, it’s not something you do to someone else
that feels like an imposition
I can only undo the latch on my joy, my care, my pain
and let them all out to rest in the meadow
When you tell me cows have best friends
that’s romantic
when you share with me a movie that means a lot to you
when you walk outside to fart
that’s romantic
We create these moments between ourselves to remember that mean so very much
And the cows dance together in the meadow
and I would want nothing more than to dance with you my dear
so let’s lean on each other like heavyweight champions 16 rounds in
let’s fall without the splat
and catch in each other’s minds
my record skips and plays again
my record skips and plays again
my record skips and plays again
take me to bed already

item.title: searching for signal
item.content:encoded:
I only forgot one thing
You
(and a sleeping pad)
oh and a neck pillow
but that’s a sad replacement for
your head against my chest
breathing with your breathing
heart beating with your beating
heart dreaming with your dreaming

I keep forgetting my earbuds
in strange between places
so I have to pay more attention
and can listen close

Sometimes you call yourself a god
and I believe it
so I can whisper across the ocean
and you could hear my prayers

It’s a secret
I want to fall in love with the world
It sometimes pours out of me into the cracks in the pavement where flowers bloom
I want to wake up and shout good morning
I want to drink up the sunrise and kiss you on the eyes and say:
"is this not heaven already?"

put your hand in mine to my heart
plant your daydreams and watch them grow
let us babble on

item.title: space a bet
item.content:encoded:
Every time I see one of those kitchy future-telling animatronics on some godforsaken pier
I always put a coin in
I shake the magic 8 ball and ask a question
I read tarot and trace palm lines to find out
I count down the days before I die
Before I left, I was in this workshop
surrounded by brilliant minds
and we were asked to predict the future
by someone who wants to leave the planet
then when he left the room
nobody had an answer
so I started talking
not caring to look like an idiot
knowing that my words would eventually catch up to my mind to the present
and carry forward the future

They wanted us to make bets
life is a casino and the every day addiction
is taking the coins for Charon
and putting them in a slot
hoping for trip-7s

It’s raining in Costa Rica
and the forecast is for more rain
but there’s eventually a dry season
how do we know these things?
how do you know the sun is going to come back up?
Blame the weatherman
Burn the witch
The prophets are delayed
the world never ends it just changes
who knows who knows who knows

when I ask you
if you want to be in the pictures at my sister’s wedding
it’s not a threat
it’s not a promise
it’s a question about a question
looking at pictures in the future
about what story I want to tell
when someone asks me who is next to me
who wants to be next to me

it rains especially when we don’t want it to
and when we dance it never comes
the prayers remain unanswered
the fortune teller asks for one more dollar
the curse remains in place
and the roulette wheel remains spinning
and I’m counting cards
and watching the rain
wishing you were here

item.title: stable genius
item.content:encoded:
You write a diss track as if that’s an explanation
When truth is there’s a lot of me that you can’t face and
conversations unfinished dangling clauses like NORAD
prevent the pilot dropping gaslight violence don’t tell me my plans

It’s hard enough in here without also managing your ego
Tell you what I’ll shut up if you stop comparing me to Nero
Hedonic supersonic treadmill I’m not that kind of people
Do my best to raise you up when I’m feeling like a zero

I want to build a world that’s been caught up in my imagination
A fucking dinosaur I’m the king feel my roar of frustration
involved not impressed give you some words of affirmation
My queen, it’s not a secret here’s the steps to domination:

Step 1: get a gun to shoot holes in the control of the population
understand you have power when you change the means of production
Step 2: tell the truth loudly and in front of all the stations
share in the care of people to form your own nation
Step 3: leave them be the ones that don’t join the revolution
pretty soon we’re worm food so they don’t deserve your salvation
Step 4: be a force that is in constant creation
mutate never abicate focus without cessation

You may think I’m a menace or trumped up in spirit
but every day I don’t write I feel I’ll die before I see it
this world that I’m shaping God complex call me Jesus
double cross at what cost

item.title: stay warm
item.content:encoded:
Never boring I
curl your words like a whisper around
my body rain outside awash in
daydreams without worries I
wrap myself in you and
feel the tension pulling loose while we
grow together as if
rooting for each other we
figured out that
the mycorrhizal sparks from my fingers in your hair
my legs twisting around yours
are the only saving grace
from the cold chill in the air

item.title: sure does
item.content:encoded:
do you want to stay up late with me?
some nights when I can’t sleep
I imagine us next to each other trying to tame dragons
most of these fears are mythical things I do to myself
burning fingers soldering
the glow of screens like embers
around the fire
let us hold hands like otters until we fall asleep

I made tea the way you taught me
two bags in a mason jar
do you remember the first night you fell asleep next to me?
like something feral
Love you wild
Love you fierce
Love you until the crows come home

I remember the wonder and joy
when you shook the algae in my closet
each little light dancing
swapping poems about how
you’ve always felt like home

I feel that glow
and when we biked to the top of the mountain
and when I didn’t have enough hands
and when we watched mayhem dig through our trash

wake me in the void
and meet me in the quiet of the morning
the soft steady quiet presence of you
tastes like memory

we can make sweet mouth sounds at each other
hold my pinkie
let’s fall asleep

item.title: thirsty
item.content:encoded:
Being with you feels like
biking with my eyes closed
like finally dropping the filters
during a funny sexy strip tease
like my favorite secret
(even though I want to tell everyone)

this is little kid stuff
sending notes during class
pretending to pay attention
while ouroborous of brains devoured
by your palm on my chest

maybe I’m not grown enough
maybe I don’t want to be
maybe all I want is to
let the storms of your pain drown me
until I learn to breathe salt water

There’s a ice blue eye in this hurricane
shot with lightning bolts of green
that send shivers through my body
when you hold my gaze

let me drink you in
I can be thirsty like the high desert
even when it hurts
calm
quiet
this horizon is endless
so that the flash flood river of your mind can snake through
and when we hold each other in the shower
we can lean against each other
weary like prizefighters
and watch the water
wash it all away

Sip my coffee
and I’ll sip your tea
and we’ll build a code language together
pillowforts during these sleepovers
try to catch summer in a bottle
race each other to the stop sign
and even though we’re both competitive
we’ll take turns letting the other win

item.title: three words
item.content:encoded:
I want to write a poem about how I love you
But we’re out of time
I’ve been saying it to myself
waiting for the right moment
that moment in your kitchen with just the two of us and the tea
In your car zooming back from the airport
the happy cocoon finding each other under the blankets
those times were when we felt like forever
before the alarm went off
I wonder how fast I can say I love you
Can we time it?
Would I be able to get an award or metal?
Fastest I love you in the west
I think in the void
so close
two black holes dissolving in the gravity
of what we were making together
I want to fall asleep next to you whenever and wherever I can
Just so that I can wake up next to you and continue the conversation we were having in my dreams
The blend of it all
You hate when I call it soup
You asked me when I started liking you
And it was too cliche to say immediately
(Also because that’d be bad form)
When I walked home that first night
talking about everything
everything had shifted
And I think you asking me that
Was your way of saying you loved me
And all the other small happy ways
I know
You know
We both know
We love you I us yes

item.title: tokyo hiatus haikus
item.content:encoded:
feelings start quiet
constructive interference
rippling rocks in pond

I witnessed your joy
museum vibrations, light
reflected your glow

item.title: tomorrow
item.content:encoded:
Tomorrow I’ll be in mountains
Tomorrow I’ll be another person
probably improbably
the impossible imposition that
takes seven years
to become a new person overnight
Tomorrow it’ll be tomorrow again
and around the edge of cliffs
I’ll see yesterday clinging to the rock face
climbing to the sun

we spend all day going up
to let what ifs pull us down
why not stay low?
the tallest dandelions have their heads chopped off
as per hindu tradition the Maharaja set fire to his widows
Doesn’t that sound like fun?

I’d rather self-immolate than hold
expectations like rats eating out of my hands
marching over my body
unceasing drowning the sky

try to catch me
I am a fever faster than the sun
I am made of small gods
spilling from my belly
I am Shiva destroyer of worlds
I am Krishna cheer the Janmashtami
I am Brahma remade in Bharat
I am Ganesha with my head cut off
Vishnu is dead
in the ice on the mountain
I am tomorrow I am tomorrow I am tomorrow
Never today

may I shiver on false peaks?
may I dive deeper and risk imploding?
may I drink from Don Juan pond?
can do sure does may be

Tomorrow

we get 3 wishes and they’re all for more genies
shaken like a magic 8 ball
ask again tomorrow

item.title: turning over four leaves
item.content:encoded:
My favorite time of year is blackberry season when everywhere feels like being outside
When I can walk and eat until I’m stained
Whenever I can I look for four leaf clovers
Maybe because I believe I’m unlucky
Maybe because I want to engineer some luck
To plan and predict and make my own
Genetically ensure that there will be fields of luck
Spread out as far as the eyes can see
That it’s preordained
as opposed to crawling on my hands and knees through the grass
Looking for something rare

On the longest day of the year my mind feels stretched like a steamroller
squeezed like juice and wrung out
a series of ducks on a line
these are the kind of days where waiting takes forever
so don’t wait anymore
the day is old
and the retirement community hasn’t served the midnight jello

Why do people ever take down Christmas lights
Why don’t spiders have wings
Why is life measured by laundry
the chime about to go off
It’s now my favorite time of night
1234
Count sheep
in a field of clover

item.title: ubuntu
item.content:encoded:
saying I miss you
isn’t enough to convey
the depth of feeling
the phantom limb ache
like an octopus
love is a distributed nervous system
stretched over the world
Stone shaped into a church
my spirit a religion built of bodies
caverns carved echo chambers into cathedrals
Where you used to be

When you walk alone in the morning sunrise of Vienna
or dance on the cobblestones of old Delhi
tears running down your face from the years
I feel the space of your body
the holiness within my own
my heart no longer a drum beat
but a harmony singing in the altar
we are, we are, we are

I am obsessed with words that do not exist
untranslatable things that we are
our true names never passing lips
the hidden desire to know and be known
at the beginning and end
we circle and share the stories
the emotional resonance of a sunrise
Life is meant to be shared
a broken promise
no matter how alone it tastes
You are part of me
always

item.title: untitled
item.content:encoded:
I’ve been gone 10 days and you’ve already slept with someone
I feel like breaking up with me would have been easier
this kind of murder-suicide feels premeditated
you took the ethical out of non-monogamy
and drove a Camry off a cliff
A self-fulfilling prophecy of being the bronze package
of being unlovable
of not being part of romance
of being alone

You realize this is how my last relationship ended
She didn’t speak out loud
the secrets she was keeping
because she was scared of what she’d find
of what I’d find
so she took the easy way out
and had sex with someone
without knowing what she wanted
without telling me

funny how it was in the same place that it happened
the curse of the east coast
when I’m having a hard time with family
I get reminded that I don’t get one of my own
I was asking you what I should tell my family about you
I was asking if you wanted to fly out to meet them
to see where I grew up
you even took off time during the same weekend
as if taunting me saying "why would I ever want to do that?"
I guess I know what to tell them about you

I asked you to form a community with me
and I thought you said yes
but maybe I misheard
it does get loud sometimes
and I’m noise sensitive
but I thought I was clear
at least with what I wanted
you could have said no

there was a moment when
paused to catch our breath
deep in the jungle
these men a generation removed
talked about how one of them loved
a woman who felt disconnected
she jumped
without realizing how much she was loved
so the moral they told us is to have those hard conversations
tell people what you want
how much you love them

relationship suicide
is when you walk to the edge of a bridge
and jump without a parachute
no preparation
no conversation
no idea of what it means to hold someone’s hand
let alone have them inside you
nobody to catch you on the way down
It’s going to be different now
I’m going to be different now
you can’t have your cake and eat it to
Hi it’s me, cake
happy birthday
I feel stampeded like
a bull in a china shop saw
that I put my heart
in the tea in the mason jar
and left it on the counter for you every morning
and decided to stomp until it was dust
being okay with being dehydrated
with not following flowcharts anymore

Before I left I said goodbye to your room
as if knowing I would never step foot in there again
I slept all day in a room that was not mine
because all I want to do is turn off my brain to stop it screaming
It all feels so temporary
you tipped this metastable state over
and squashed me like a bug
the police will chalk my outline
and they’ll say it was a crime of passion

item.title: walk the labyrinth
item.content:encoded:
I hope you get everything you ever wanted
and I never hear about it
I loved a ghost
she changed her name
and carved away the person
I wanted to build a life with
So i echo as you walk
my heart a cathedral
not caring about the stares

I vomit these words
overdosing on sorrow
finally purging
stumble into the street
climb Bernal one more time

Empty
I start noticing the wind
the grass shifting
Walk the labyrinth
my body an empty church
this is the cemetery
let me put this heart to rest
I walk
tripping over myself
dropping pieces as I go
cutting myself on the shards that remain
my blood a clear white
my tears a deep red
it’s raining now
harder than I’ve seen before
I am here
this place cannot shake me
I am now
my wings unfurl
weak and flimsy
fresh and new
I am ready to see again
I find sea glass at the center
deep ice blue-green
so familiar

item.title: wound up
item.content:encoded:
Let the soft human of my body go
Taste the start of fall on my breath
Walk the labyrinth
Test the flowers of their patience
These commandments on the mountain
To get lost; to echo truth
To make big promises and keep them
To separate the narrow path from the range
Climbing mountains never feels right until the end
Pain is a real thing
Like ashes in your mouth
Reminder that you burn bright
And there is only so much room around your fire

I sometimes wake up afraid that my mouth is sewn shut
that these words aren’t enough
that these bones will become dust and I
wish that I was bigger than the person that I am
I bury myself in sheets and burn down all my plans and I
wonder if my parents felt the same way
If they pretended that the dreams they held were shit they couldn’t say and I
never had a broken bone so you can’t say that I’ve healed
I’ve never been told to be quiet trying to shout the things I feel and I
wouldn’t wish silence on my worst enemy
these words pile up like a car wreck deep inside of me and I
love being around you because it feels like you punch a hole through the paper bag soul of me
hold me letting it flow out like it’s okay it’s okay it’s okay
we bleed and it’s okay these things like stab wounds
let them run until they’re dry
In EMT training they taught me you never pull out a knife
you leave it in and I remember thinking: does that mean for life?
what happens after we drop them off at the ER isn’t up to me but letting go is the hardest thing
it’s like unwrapping a bandage around this knife and pulling it out of me
and I’m afraid I’ll never stop bleeding
and I’m afraid that I won’t have any more life to give
and that if I do it I’ll die
that these words will flow and I’ll die on the pavement
and they’ll say: he shouldn’t have taken the knife out

item.title: List of funding sources for your biotech project so you don’t have to move in with your parents
item.description: List of funding sources for your biotech project so you don’t have to move in with your parents
item.content:encoded:
Getting bank. Printing paper. Securing the bag.

In the beginning stages of your journey as a biotech founder, it’s hella difficult to get $$$ to test out your brilliant idea.

I’ve been there. I’ve built labs in everything from a bullet-hole-ridden garage space in po-dunk Virginia, to the attic of a haunted mansion, to a shipping container cooking in the parking lot of an LA summer.

Yes, I’m jaded. If I had money I’d throw it at you. But I don’t. So instead you should check out this list of kind people who make sure you don’t have to weird out your parents with trying to make sperm drug delivery carriers.

Also because y’all will probably go through and open every single link here to completely destroy your computer’s tab count and make the onboard fan on your laptop scream like a banshee, I’ve made it easier on you by including them all in this link.

Funding for young people (sub-25 ish):

776 Foundation ($100k): Focused on climate, founded by Alexis Ohanian (reddit dude).

Thiel Fellowship ($100k): The OG drop-out-of-school-and-build-something.

Magnificent Grants ($100k): (DJ Khaled voice) Another one. Drop out. You wouldn’t.

LocalHost ($100k): Drop out but this time… from high school???!?!?!?!?!!!

Z Fellows ($10k): Interesting people. Founders Fund?

These don’t give you money but they seem like good communities/fellowships that definitely aren’t cults:

Foresight: Really cool old school network of folks in frontier technology.

Polaris: UK-based crew of folks working at the edge of the possible.

Longevity Biotech: a one-of-a-kind longevity fellowship.

Time Initiative: a one-of-a-kind longevity fellowship.

QB3: Advisory program in the bay area with tons of connections.

Berkeley I-Corps: Do it. It’s like eating your vegetables. Probably the healthiest thing for your idea is to talk to customers.

5050: Set up by 50 Years, seems legit.

Activator: No cost biotech accelerator.

Small Chunks of Funding for Experiments (non-dilutive):

Awesome Foundation ($1k): Nice group of 10ish people who put in $100 each and give out a grant a month.

1517 Medici Grants ($1k): Investor group that gives out funds for interesting sci-fi projects.

Emergent Ventures (up to $15k): Doing something weird and counterculture? Tyler Cowen wants to know about it and give you $$$.

Experiment.com Grants (crowdfunding): David Lang has been doing the lord’s work in adding fuel to the fire that is grassroots research.

Homeworld (variable): Do you not want the world to steadily asphyxiate from CO2? Neither do Dan Goodwin and Paul Reginato.

ACX Grant (variable): Once a year by Scott Alexander to whatever he thinks is cool.

ValleyDAO (variable): Those dudes Albert and Morgan who want to make things happen in biotech.

If you’re doing biotech things, here’s a list of stuff to get early larger non — dilutive funding/support:

Astera + Astera ($125–250k): Really Cate Hall, Seemay Chou and Jed McCaleb are single-handedly trying to shift the philanthropic ecosystem towards supporting alternative forms of research. Really cool to see.

National Science Foundation (up to $250k): The government will give you money to work on interesting things. No strings attached except for a headache of paperwork but I swear it’s worth it.

Longevity (?): just found this one so I don’t know too much but seems fine.

Activate ($275k): Cool program that hooks you up with labspace, money and more.

Breakthrough ($50–500k): Bill Gates is making it rain to stop acid rain (and more). Climate-focused generally.

Echoing Green ($100k): Also climate focused and for underserved founders.

O’Shaughnessy ($100k): Hard to pronounce, nice to get.

Once you’ve really got things going, then it’s time to hit up the Vulture Capitalists. Here’s some good funds with easy applications:

SciFounder: Founded by Nish + others, they’re good technical folks.

NFX Bio: I think Omri is still running this.

Boost VC: The younger Draper has an awesome group of founders in a cohort.

PearX: Not sure about this one but they seem nice and have good snacks.

IndieBio: The original synthetic biology funders. I went through in 2016 and still heavily recommend to get started.

Berkeley SkyDeck: Nice terms + lots of Berkeley alum support.

YCombinator: The original. Really helps with fundraising.

Sidenote:

Just going to plug this program I got into — the OnDeck Fellowship. I’ll check them out and let y’all know how it goes.

Conclusion

Okay now that you’ve made it to the very end, I’ve actually included a link of links with all of the applications here. Have fun, make good choices and build cool shit.

item.title: Happy Noggin
item.content:encoded:
Low Cost EEG + Brainwave Entrainment

A few weeks ago I had the good fortune of participating in an AI + Global Health hackathon over at Studio 45.

I’m in the period of time in my life where I have the ability and time to play, experiment, invent and learn. One of the ideas I’ve been kicking around for a bit has been around brainwave entrainment.

Brainwave entrainment is the steady stimulation of light and sound to influence deeper waves to form in the brain. There are numerous research papers that show distinctive benefits to this kind of stimulation and the same kind of effect has been shown in a variety of cultural activities ranging from Buddhist chanting to house music.

A few months ago I met and became friends with Ben. He had been looking into treatments for his mom’s dementia and discovered brainwave entrainment. At the same time I found these Trip Glasses for $2 at the thrift store that were made by Mitch Altman. I started using the Trip Glasses and felt a distinctive benefit, reducing the amount of time I needed to sleep while improving my overall readiness scores (improvements in HRV, length of REM, etc).

We came together during the hackathon to build a neurofeedback device that took in EEG patterns and then created a constructive or destructive interference pattern with light and sound stimulation to either enhance attention and focus, or lead to relaxation and sleep.

We were joined by Ray, an amazing electrical engineer and spent 24 hours building a fun prototype of a neurofeedback device we called Happy Noggin.

Upon presenting, we got honorable mention for the project!

I’m aiming to continue the work by building a simplified 2-channel EEG + stimulation PCB to make a prototype consumer device. If you’re interested in learning more + following along make sure to ping me for more details.

item.title: Warspite: Anti-war Enzymes
item.content:encoded:
Using AI Tools to Generate Enzymes that Break Down Land Mines

The contamination of soil with explosives, particularly RDX (Research Department Explosive), due to the widespread use of landmines poses a significant environmental and humanitarian challenge. These land mines cover a total surface area the size of Wyoming and lead to the death of thousands of children every year.

Current remediation methods are costly, slow, and often impractical in conflict zones. This project proposes to harness synthetic biology to engineer soil bacteria capable of degrading RDX in contaminated environments. By integrating specific metabolic pathways into native soil bacteria, we aim to create a sustainable and cost-effective bioremediation strategy. This approach not only promises to mitigate the environmental impact of RDX but also offers a potential tool for demining operations in affected regions.

RDX (Cyclotrimethylenetrinitramine) is a highly stable and toxic explosive compound widely used in military munitions, including landmines. Its persistence in the environment, particularly in soil, presents long-term ecological risks, including groundwater contamination and adverse effects on plant and animal life. Traditional remediation techniques, such as excavation and incineration, are both environmentally disruptive and economically prohibitive, especially in large-scale applications. Moreover, these methods are not feasible in war-torn regions where landmines are prevalent.

Bioremediation, the use of living organisms to detoxify contaminated environments, offers a promising alternative. However, natural degradation of RDX by microbes is inefficient due to the compound’s stability. Synthetic biology provides an opportunity to enhance the degradation capabilities of soil bacteria by introducing engineered metabolic pathways capable of breaking down RDX into non-toxic byproducts.

Over the course of a few hours, I worked with a team of folks to screen a number of enzymes in silico, then model the binding affinity for RDX and benchmark these enzymes to determine the right starting place for in silico mutagenesis. Next up would be generating a library of potential mutants and doing a fluorescent screen on them over on our OT-2 at Cellsius. Just a fun little weekend project that I hope will make the world a safer place.

item.title: What are the types of things which are better built with others? Why?
item.description: What are the types of things which are better built with others? Why?
item.content:encoded:
Unless there is an audience of one (which is so very rarely the case unless you’re making something solely for yourself), every single type of thing that is created by people could benefit from having more than one person involved. I used to be part of a book writing class that specifically was built because there’s a myth that creative work happens when people toil alone. It is always a collaborative effort. Having multiple perspectives brings a diversity of thought, preventing blind spots, enables more to be done, expands the potential impact and sustains the project when energy, resources or effort wanes from an individual. While there is a definite benefit to having more than one person involved in whatever endeavor, be it merely for feedback or for collaborative effort, there is a maximum number of people to be effective in a group setting. IBM (or Intel? I don’t know, I’m on a plane and can’t look this up) conducted a study on the effectiveness of teams and determined a mathematical principle that the amount of communication increases by x^n + 1 for each new member added to the team. At a certain point the amount of communication time exceeds the amount of work time necessary for a project to be sustained. This means there is an optimal number of people for the minimum amount of communication while maintaining the effectiveness of the team’s work. The number is <=7 people, otherwise known as the pizza party principle. You want to work in a team of this size or smaller as communication is effective and direct, while the productivity of the team is maximized. I think the other key word in this question is “better” — this hints at the question of what team forms the best possible environment for creation.

A big factor at play is human specialization.
